title: XML parser without visible hardening (XXE) — review required
description: A newly created JAXP DocumentBuilderFactory resolves external entities unless secure processing is enabled, which lets a malicious XML document read local files or probe the network (XXE). This lexical rule flags factory creation; the reviewer must confirm hardening flags are set.
remediation: Call setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true) (or setXIncludeAware(false) plus setExpandEntityReferences(false)) immediately after creating the factory, before newDocumentBuilder(). Prefer a minimal XML profile when full XML is unneeded.
limitation: Lexical: flags the factory name, not the hardening calls, so hardened parsers match too. Confirm the flags in review; SAX/DOM alternatives are out of scope.
